exposure: Presence/absence of associated cerebral and extracerebral anomalies
outcome: Neurodevelopmental outcomes (normal, mild delay, severe delay)
cohort: The study included 51 neonates identified over a 17-year period with agenesis of corpus callosum (ACC) or hypoplasia of the corpus callosum.
finding: Callosal defects are frequently accompanied by brain and somatic anomalies, and additional abnormalities were significantly associated with developmental delay and increased risk of epilepsy.
